method_definition: GPT-6 Astra via Codex CLI generates Blender Python scene code; fixed Blender construction and rendering; procedural geometry and materials, no external scene assets
proposed_method_definition: GPT-6 Astra generates Blender scene code; a fixed renderer produces Table-2 views
api_seed_note: Logical seeds index fresh independent Codex CLI sessions; no deterministic model seed is supported. Preserve the returned code for deterministic local reconstruction. CLI JSONL does not return a model snapshot identifier.
notes: Original pilot generation used codex-cli 0.153.2. The user restored the execution environment with 0.153.4 on 2026-09-08; validate the same gpt-6-astra transport before formal freezing. Preserve prior pilot manifests and generated code; do not regenerate quality failures.

Scene construction definition confirmed by user; Codex CLI connectivity passed. Freeze renderer and validator after pilot. CLI does not expose the former API max_output_tokens setting; timeout and reasoning effort are recorded instead.
Reuse existing metric environments and caches without modifying other methods or shared frozen lock files.
Unstarted runs are missing data, not observed failures; never synthesize ITT scores for them.
Do not substitute another model, another method's scenes or simulated human ratings.

IQA production uses batch 1 only: repeat delta 0 on the fixed 10-image pilot. CLIP-IQA+ batch-8 diagnostic exceeded the suggested 1e-4 tolerance and is not approved. Q-Align batch 8 and CPU fp16 LLM validation were not supported/tested; do not claim all diagnostic modes passed.
